## Do you Know What an Alternative Product Is?

An alternative product, therefore, is an item presented as a replacement or comparable choice to the one a customer is currently viewing or considering. Specifically, these alternatives offer similar functions or benefits, allowing customers to choose based on factors such as price, brand, quality, or specific characteristics. ### 04. Adobe Commerce

Adobe Commerce is a robust eCommerce platform for businesses looking to scale and introduce advanced customizations to their online stores. Formerly known as Magento, Adobe Commerce offers advanced tools (including generative AI) for creating a business website that can handle high traffic and complex product catalogs. It’s ideal for enterprises seeking a highly tailored web design and seamless integration with other Adobe products.
